transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. Can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well… it’s the situation in my building. For months the property manager and some of the people there have been doing things—misdelivered mail, noises in the walls at certain times, comments from neighbors that are clearly meant for me. It’s like they’re trying to push me out of the apartment. They have paperwork and explanations, but… it doesn’t change the pattern.
Besides feeling that people are targeting you, have you ever heard voices, sounds, or sensed presences that others couldn't perceive?
No… not voices. I mean, I hear the noises in the building, but those are real noises. As far as sensing presences or things other people can’t perceive… I don’t think so.

Aside from this situation with your building, how have things been going for you at work and with your friends or family—are you still able to keep up with your usual responsibilities and relationships?
Mostly, yes. I mean… outside of the apartment issue, I pay my bills, cook, keep appointments. If I’m talking about consulting work or painting, I can stay organized. I still manage the usual things.

Do you have any medical conditions—like a neurological illness, head injury, thyroid problems, or use of medications, drugs, or alcohol—that started around the same time these beliefs about your building began?
Not that I’m aware of. I mean… nothing new that started then, as far as I can tell. I don’t really use drugs or anything like that.
Have you noticed any recent changes in your memory, concentration, or episodes of confusion, headaches, or seizures around the time these beliefs about your building started?
No, I don’t think so. My memory’s… about the same, as far as I can tell. I haven’t had confusion or anything like seizures. Headaches, not really beyond normal now and then.
How long have you been noticing and believing that the property manager and neighbors are trying to push you out of your apartment?
About… eleven months, I think. It started pretty soon after I moved into that apartment.
